name: Opera House
summary: Opera facade on Đồng Khởi: see the arch by day, or a show of about an hour on a ticketed night. The building is at 07 Công trường Lam Sơn, about 600 metres from Bạch Đằng. Nhà hát Thành phố is a Line 1 station. Lune Production stages circus and cultural shows several nights a week.
timeNeeded: The facade is a stop on the walk. A show runs about an hour. Check on arrival.
getThere: Walk on Đồng Khởi. Nhà hát Thành phố is a Line 1 station.
heroCaption: The cream facade, the arch, and the street in front

notice.title: By day, the visit is the facade
notice.body: A night show needs a ticket. Ask at the door for a daytime hour and for which nights are on.

body: The facade sits on Đồng Khởi, on the walk from the cathedral. The address is 07 Công trường Lam Sơn, Bến Nghé, about 600 metres from Bạch Đằng. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 3.1 km. By day the visit is the arch and the street.

At night Lune Production stages circus and cultural shows several nights a week, about an hour. The station Nhà hát Thành phố is one of the three underground stations on Line 1, with Bến Thành and Ba Son. The second photograph is the building from the side.

figures.caption: The opera house from the side, in a different hour
figures.alt: Saigon Opera House seen from the side of the street

gettingThere: Walk Đồng Khởi from the cathedral. The house is at 07 Công trường Lam Sơn, about 600 metres from Bạch Đằng. From the Jade Emperor Pagoda the distance is about 3.1 km.

legs.heading: From Bạch Đằng
legs.body: About 600 metres to 07 Công trường Lam Sơn.

legs.heading: By metro
legs.body: Line 1, station Nhà hát Thành phố. Check the board for the fare.

hours: Check on arrival for a daytime interior hour. Shows run several nights a week.
admissionNote: Check on arrival for the building and for the Lune show.
